snippet.title: Grizzy & The Lemmings: Crazy Party | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The chaos is here! Grizzy & The Lemmings: Crazy Party is OUT NOW on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and Epic.

👉 Get it now on Nintendo Switch: https://go.balio.games/buy/crazyparty/nintendo

PlayStation 5: https://go.balio.games/buy/crazyparty/playstation
Xbox: https://go.balio.games/buy/crazyparty/xbox
Steam: https://go.balio.games/buy/crazyparty/steam
Epic: https://go.balio.games/buy/crazyparty/epic


Join Grizzy and the Lemmings in their very first console game! Challenge your family and friends in a completely wacky party game where anything goes. Playable with up to 4 players in local multiplayer, it is the perfect experience for game nights full of laughs, traps, and endless surprises.

🎮 50 Wild Mini-Games: From kart races to snowball fights and dinosaur chases, the action never stops.

🗺️ 5 Unique Boards: Explore varied environments packed with surprises and shortcuts.

🐻 40 Playable Characters: Play as your favorite characters from the animated series and fill out your 150-sticker album.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Local Multiplayer (1-4 Players): Face off on the same couch to see who will be the king of the forest!

Passionately developed by Balio Studio.
Don't miss any of our updates by following us on social media:
